Dialogs.Dialog: Do girls write poems and stuff when they fall in love？
Anegasaki
Eh!?
What's wrong？
Ah, no, nothing... I don't think they usually write much, normally.
I see...
I don't write any, okay？
When people wear thin clothes, they can end up see-through, huh.
Anegasaki
...Geez. What are you saying all of a sudden？
Yeah... I mean ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ should be careful too.
Ah, getting possessive？
That's not what I meant...
Hehe, I'll be careful for you.
If humans grew tails, where would they grow from...
Anegasaki
What's that？
Around here, maybe... or around here...？
Ahah, what are you doing？
Ah... hahaha, nothing.
...Fishnet stockings...
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ ...Are you tired？
Ah, Teach... I mean, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. It's nothing.
If so, fine, but you'd better not suddenly mutter "fishnet stockings" to yourself, okay？ People will think you're weird.
...I'll be careful.
Ah, Nene-sama.
Anegasaki
Huh!? Wh-what's that？
Ah... no reason... hahaha.
Geez, you always try to laugh things off... hehe, but you're cute, so I'll forgive you.
(The mischievous ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was also cute...)
Anegasaki
Hehe... hot springs are nice, aren't they？
Yesterday, I tried putting hot spring bath salts in my bath. Hehe, doesn't my skin feel different？
Yeah, the nape of your neck was so pretty...
Huh, did you say something？
No. Your skin really does look prettier than usual, hahaha.
Anegasaki
Hey, got a sec？
What's wrong？
Just stay still for a sec, okay...
Wh-whoa！ Something on my neck!?
Your collar was messed up, so I just fixed it, okay？ What's got you so flustered？ Hehe.
Th-thanks... phew, that startled me...
Anegasaki
Hey, do you think I've gained weight lately...？
Not at all！ I can't tell just by looking.
Really？ Then that's good.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is always young and slim！
...？ Thanks...
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ Why do you look so serious？
Is there anywhere you want to go right now？ Anything you want to eat, or... um...
...Hehe, what's this all of a sudden？
I wondered if you had any complaints about me...
Geez, as long as you're with me, that's enough, okay？
Anegasaki
Mm... ahem.
What's wrong, a cold？ Should I nurse you!?
Huh？ No, I'm fine. My throat just tickled a bit... ah. Or do you want to try nursing me？
Yeah, I'll feed you grated apple and everything.
Geez, I'm not that much of a kid.
Anegasaki
Ah, here you are.
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Need something from me？
It's not anything big, but... you know, today is... right？ If it's not a bother...
Ah, is this chocolate？ Thanks！
I might have messed it up a little... so if it's not good, sorry.
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ made it, it's bound to be delicious.
Like I said... I messed up a little. I tasted it, but I'm not confident at all that it'll suit your taste...
Nope, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s chocolate is definitely delicious. I've decided！
Aah, geez, meanie... but maybe I'm a little happy. Hehe, thanks.
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. Geez... could it be you forgot what day today is？
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
...Hmm. I see. You did forget, after all.
I was planning to give homemade chocolate to the person I'm dating... did I get the wrong person？
Today's Valentine's Day！ Sorry, I remember now！
You don't have to force yourself to take it, you know？ There might be someone else out there who'd take it？
Please give it to me！ I'm sorry！ Please！
Hehe. For my cute boyfriend who apologizes so honestly... here, your reward.
Anegasaki
Ah, found you！ Geez, I was looking for you.
Huh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
I have a special chocolate just for cute boys... what'll you do？
...Ah, today's Valentine's Day. Thanks, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
But before that... did you get any from other girls this year？ If you confess now, I'll go easy on you？
I'd even forgotten until ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ mentioned it...
...Then, mine is your only chocolate this year？
Yeah, I guess so...？
Then... ahem... thank you for always being with me. Will you accept this chocolate filled with tons of love？
Yeah... thank you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm really happy.
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. Hey, you, my junior. Come here a sec.
Junior？ Me？
Never mind that, here... chocolate.
For Valentine's Day!?
It's an obligation one, technically... so don't think too deeply about it, okay？
But getting one from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I'm happy.
Hehe. If you're that happy, it makes me happy too. Ah... could it be you like sweets？
Yeah... I guess？
If you have preferences, tell me. I'll use it for future reference. Hehe.
Okay... future？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey.
Anegasaki
Ah, what's up？
Yeah. Today's White Day, so... a thank-you for Valentine's.
Wow... ah, but did you push yourself？ Are you okay？
Don't worry about that. Open it.
Wow... can I really have this？ I'm so happy...
(Looks like she really loved it.)
Thank you. I'll treasure it.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
Um... it's the thought that counts, right？ Thank you.
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
Getting a return gift from you... I'm so moved.
Moved... it's really not anything that big.
But you picked it out for me, right？ When I think that, I'm so happy... is that weird？
It's not weird, but it's kind of embarrassing...
Me too... hehe, I wonder if you'll still be embarrassed next year？
Next year already？
Well, it's a once-a-year event, right？ Sigh... what should I do for next year's chocolate？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey.
Anegasaki
Ah, what's wrong？
Today's White Day, so I brought you a thank-you for Valentine's.
Hehe. If you really insist on giving me something back, maybe I'll accept it？
Yeah, I really insist... so. Here, open it.
Wow, lovely... hehe, you really know my taste. That's a little surprising？
(Looks like she really loved it.)
A decent choice, I guess？ Hehe.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
...I'll take it, I suppose.
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
Getting a return gift... did I make you go to too much trouble？
Don't be like that. I was really happy about the chocolate...
Hehe, thanks. Then next year I'll have to prepare an even bigger chocolate.
Bigger...
Um... I-I'll do my best.
Hehe. Kidding, kidding. Just the thought alone makes me pretty satisfied... you know？
Okay... then next year too, I'll give you something back without overdoing it.
Ah, there you are. Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Ah, need something？ Hehe, what could it be, I can't imagine.
Seems like you see right through me... here, a White Day present.
Yay, thanks！ Honestly, I was reaaally looking forward to it！
Open it. I'm worried whether you'll like it...
Wow... thank you！ Could it be you can read my mind？
(Looks like she really loved it.)
Ah... you picked this out for me. Hehe, thanks.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
...Yeah, thanks.
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
I thought maybe you'd forgotten White Day...
Come on. I wouldn't forget.
Aww, my punishment set went to waste.
Punishment...
If you'd forgotten White Day, things would've gotten so much more fun～.
Come on, don't scare me...
Hehe. Maybe it would've been better if you'd forgotten？ Because I was planning to do all sorts of things to you... until I was satisfied.
...Huh？
Pfft... geez, your face is bright red. Hehe, so cute...
Um... ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. There you are.
Anegasaki
Hm？ What's up？
Yeah, today's White Day, so... here, a present.
Wow, thank you. Hehe, can I open it here？
Of course.
Lovely... I never expected to get a return gift like this.
(Looks like she really loved it.)
Hehe. Thank you for the lovely return gift.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
...Hm？ Thanks.
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
But... you didn't have to give me anything back. Did I put you out？
Not at all.
But what I gave you was just chocolate, you know？
But it was chocolate with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s heart in it...
Huh... my heart...？
Ah... did I say something weird？
No. You didn't say anything weird... I think？
Yeah？ Then good...
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ You look kind of...
No, nothing... by the way, um, you see... I kind of forgot...
...I see. It's fine. Getting something back isn't the point. I'm fine. Even if it's one-way...
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
Anegasaki
Ah... hehe, what's wrong？ You seemed to panic the moment you saw me？
Um... you see, today's, that thing...
Hmm. So that's all it means to you. Got it.
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
Anegasaki
Ah, what's wrong？ You seem flustered.
Um... Sorry！ I totally forgot that today is White Day...
I see... it's fine. Don't worry about it. I was looking forward to it a little, but...
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
Anegasaki
What's wrong？
Um... sorry！ I forgot to get you a White Day gift！
Ah... I see. If that's how it is, it can't be helped. Yeah, I don't really... you know？
(I'm the biggest idiot in the land！)
(All right, today's the sports festival.)
The events are finally starting. I'm weirdly nervous.
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. We're in different grades, but let's both do our best.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did you come to cheer me on？
Hehe. I came to watch you shine.
Yeah, thanks... all right, I'll do my best！
Ah, but be careful not to get hurt. If anything starts hurting, tell me, okay？
It's fine. It's not like I'm doing anything dangerous.
Okay... anyway, do your best without overdoing it.
(All right, nailed it！)
Anegasaki
I guess I had you pegged right？ Hehe, you were amazing out there.
It's thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ cheering me on.
Saying such cute things. Want me to pat your head？
N-no thanks. Everyone's watching...
Hehe, so cute...
(Glad I've been training all along...)
(That was a total bust...)
Anegasaki
That was a little unfortunate.
Sorry, after you cheered me on.
No. You did your best, right？ Isn't that enough？
But... it's a little frustrating.
If you feel that way, you'll be fine next time. I'm rooting for you. Okay？
(I should have trained more...)
(All right, today's the culture festival.)
Anegasaki
Hey, I heard from a friend... are you entering the Handsome Boy Contest？
Yeah... word's spread all the way to you, huh.
That's amazing, I was surprised.
I kind of got pushed into it... I'll get knocked out right away anyway.
Who knows？ You might go pretty far, you know？
Really？
Yeah, I guarantee it.
Hmm, maybe I'll try a little harder？
Hehe. I'm rooting for you too, so do your best.
(I ended up winning the contest...)
Anegasaki
Congratulations！ You actually won！
It was a fluke...
That's not true, you know？ I absolutely think you're cool.
...Huh？
Hehe. Stay a wonderful guy from now on too, okay？
(Glad I always paid attention to my looks...)
(The contest was a bust...)
Anegasaki
So close... you were almost there.
The other contestants were all good-looking guys.
That's not true. To me, you're...
The judges just have no eye for it. Geez, why can't they see it...
(Maybe I should pay a bit more attention to my looks...)
Wow, it's really lively...
Anegasaki
Merry Christmas. It's a lovely night.
Merry Christmas. Celebrating with everyone is nice too.
Right. Something like this might be nice once in a while.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s dress really suits you... you look like a grown woman.
Oh, geez... don't tease me.
Um... I have a Christmas present for you...
Thanks. I have one for you too.
Then, shall we exchange？
Yeah...
Wow... lovely... I think I'll never forget this Christmas as long as I live...
(Looks like she really loved it.)
Wow, thanks. I like this kind of thing too.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
Um... thanks. You worked hard to pick it out, right？
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
Hey, about my present...
A present？ Like from Santa Claus？
Huh？ Ah... never mind...
(Crap, should I have gotten her a present？)
Hey, do you have... a little time？
Hm？
Well then, I'll head home...
I see. Bye, then...
Wow, it's really lively...
Anegasaki
Merry Christmas. It's a really lively party, huh.
Merry Christmas. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you look good in that dress.
Oh my, thank you. So you've learned how to flatter now.
It's not flattery.
Hehe, since it's Christmas, I'll take it at face value.
By the way, I have a present for you？
Really？ I have one too.
Hehe, then let's exchange？
Yeah...
Wow... hehe, this passes. Thank you. I'll treasure it.
(Looks like she really loved it.)
Hehe. A pass, I guess. Thanks. You know my taste better than I thought.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
Hmm... needs a little more work, I guess？ Hehe, I'll look forward to next year.
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
Ah, come to think of it... a present！
A present？ Santa Claus stopped coming to my house a long time ago...
Hm？
Geez, never mind...
(Crap, should I have gotten her a present？)
Will you come somewhere with me after this？
I'll be heading home, so, bye...
I see. Bye, then...
Wow, it's really lively...
Anegasaki
Merry Christmas. It's quite the grand party.
Merry Christmas... that dress really suits you.
Hehe, flattering me all of a sudden... what are you planning, hitting on me now？
It's not flattery...
Thanks. More than anyone else's praise, yours makes me happiest.
Oh right. I have a Christmas present from Santa Nene？
Thanks, I'm ready to play Santa too, you know？
Hehe, then let's exchange？
Yeah...
Wow... I never thought I'd get such a lovely present from you... yeah, I'll treasure it forever.
(Looks like she really loved it.)
Lovely... thank you, I'll treasure it.
(Well, I guess that's about right.)
...Hehe. I'll look forward to how you grow, I guess？
(Looks like she didn't really like it...)
Hey, are you ready to be Santa？
Haha. I graduated from Santa Claus a long time ago.
...Geez, dummy.
(Crap, should I have gotten her a present？)
There's somewhere I want to go together. Will you come with me after this？
Hm？
Ah, I have to go home... bye？
I see. Bye, then...
Wow, it's really lively...
Anegasaki
Merry Christmas！ Enjoying the party？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... that dress really suits you.
Huh, really？ That's a little embarrassing...
A quiet holy night is nice, but parties like this are nice too.
Yeah.
Don't you have anyone to spend Christmas with？
No. But I got to talk with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like this, so it's not bad？
Geez, smooth talker. You shouldn't tease your elders. No！
(Treated like a kid again...)
Anegasaki
Wow... look. The tree's all lit up, it's so pretty...
Just lighting it up really changes the impression.
It's a bit chilly, but I'm glad we came after dark after all... achoo.
Are you cold？
Yeah, just a little.
Should we head back before you catch a cold？
No. I'm fine. I want to be with you a little longer...
Are you really okay？
I'm fine... ah, then, will you hold my hand？
Sure？
Thanks. Yeah, so warm... ehehe.
You're right... somehow I'm getting warmer too.
...I want to be like this together next year too.
Yeah, next year too.
...And the year after？
Of course. If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is okay with it, for life... you know.
Huh, for life...
Yeah...
I'm... glad I'm your girlfriend...
Yeah, me too... yeah...
Anegasaki
Wow... hehe, was it too soon for us to see such a romantic place together？
You think？
Hehe. I mean it's that pretty. I've always dreamed of spending Christmas at a place like this with a wonderful boyfriend.
A wonderful boyfriend...
Ideals and reality are different things, huh.
...Well, I guess I can't really be called an ideal boyfriend, but...
Hehe. What are you saying？ I mean you're even better than my ideal.
A cuter, more wonderful, more dependable boyfriend than I ever imagined...
That's... a bit of an exaggeration...
Do you think I'm teasing you？ If so, that's fine too, hehe.
Yeah... I'll do my best to live up to it.
Hehe, that's the spirit, that's the spirit. Let's keep it up next year too.
And the year after that, and beyond.
Yeah. From now on too, stay the coolest boy in the world, the one I always celebrate Christmas with.
Anegasaki
Look, look, the tree's shining. It's so pretty...
Hehe. What's wrong？
No, nothing...
I always dreamed of celebrating Christmas here with my boyfriend.
If the actual boyfriend is someone like me, it's not that great, huh...
Geez, that's not true. Hehe, what's wrong today？ You're like a sulking kid.
That's... because ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so beautiful...
...Yeah, thanks. But you know, you're a far more wonderful boyfriend than the one in my dreams. Okay？
...Really？
Really. I never imagined Christmas with such a cute boyfriend.
Besides... when I think I'll get to watch up close as you become an even more wonderful man...
Hehe. I guarantee it. You'll definitely become a really wonderful man.
When ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ says so, I feel kind of confident... I guess？
But... sometimes I wonder, when you become a wonderful man, if I'll be the one by your side...
That's obvious. I'm the one who wants you with me forever.
...Hehe, thanks. Then it's a promise just between us, okay？ Next year, the year after, always celebrating Christmas together... okay？
Yeah, I promise. Always together...
It's cold... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ should be here soon.
Anegasaki
Happy New Year.
Happy New Year, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Here's to another year.
Yeah. Same here.
Um. Your kimono looks great on you.
Hehe, thanks.
Then, shall we go for our first shrine visit？
Okay... done？
Anegasaki
Yeah.
Hey, what did you wish for this year？
Probably the same thing as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Huh!? No way... really？
Hm？ Your face is red, could it be you're cold？
Ah, no, it's not that, I mean... geez...
Anegasaki
Phew... it was so crowded.
Yeah. But I'm glad we got to pray properly.
Hey, hey. Are you the type who thinks once you've done your New Year's prayer, the year will be fine？
What do you mean？
Um, well, I pray, "I'll work hard again this year, so please watch over me."
Huh, that's positive.
Yeah. Aren't you like that？
For me it's more like, "Please take care of me again this year."
Then I'll pray to you too.
To me!?
Yeah. Please go out with me nicely again this year.
Yeah. Likewise.
Anegasaki
Well then... see you.
Yeah, see you.
Hehe.
Hm？
Let's come again.
Yeah, next year too.
Yeah, bye-bye.
It's really hot...
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry. Did I keep you waiting...？
Not at all. More importantly, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, the yukata really suits you.
Ah, thanks. Ehehe...
Then, shall we go to the shrine？
Anegasaki
Wow. More people than I thought.
Yeah. If we're careless, we might get separated.
Should we... hold hands？
...Huh？
Well, you know. It'd be bad if we got separated...
...Yeah, right. Okay.
Hehe. Hold on tight so we don't get separated... okay？
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, boys like masks, don't they？
Really？ Ah, come to think of it, I used to get them bought for me a lot when I was little.
Hehe. Then shall I buy you one？
No thanks. That's too embarrassing now.
It's a festival, so it's fine. Come on, let's pick together. We'll match. Okay？
Anegasaki
Wow... Beautiful.
Yeah, amazing. ...Huh？ Are you crying？ What's wrong？
Ah, yeah, sorry. It was so pretty, tears just came out.
Are you okay？
Yeah. I hope we can watch them together again next summer.
Yeah. Let's watch them together again next year.
...Yeah.
Ta～ma～ya～！
Anegasaki
Hehe. Hey, hey, do you know the word that goes with it？
Yeah. "Kagiya," right？
Right, correct. "Tamaya" and "Kagiya" were both shop names of famous fireworks makers long ago.
Then, do you know which one came first？
Hmm, which was it？
The answer is...
I don't know either, actually.
What's that supposed to mean？
Ah, look. The next one's going up.
Ka～gi～ya～！
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, I did a test of courage at this shrine once. In middle school. With the neighborhood kids' association.
Huh, usually they wouldn't like people doing that.
The head priest's older brother was the neighborhood association head back then. So the plan got approved, apparently.
So you took part？ Was it scary？
It was scary. I had to sit alone in the dark the whole time until people came.
...Sitting alone？ Why？
Huh？ Because I was a ghost. I had to hide and scare people, right？
Ah！ So that's what you meant by taking part!?
Yeah. A ghost cat, by the way. With cat ears stuck on.
(If anything, I'd like to see that.)
Anegasaki
Ugh. That really was a bit heavy. The grilled squid...
Maybe I should have stopped at cotton candy and corn.
I told you so.
But it looked so good...
There's still half the grilled squid left, though...
Mmm. I can't anymore.
It's fine. I'll eat it for you.
Okay... here. Sorry.
Leave it to me.
We ate the same amount, though. You really are a guy.
Anegasaki
Thanks for walking me home.
I can't let my girlfriend walk home alone at night.
Hehe. Well then... see you.
Yeah, see you.
It's really hot...
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry. Did I keep you waiting...？
Not at all. More importantly, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, the yukata really suits you.
Ah, thanks. Ehehe...
Then, shall we go to the Bay Bridge？
Anegasaki
Wow... Beautiful.
Yeah, amazing. ...Huh？ Are you crying？ What's wrong？
Ah, yeah, sorry. It was so pretty, tears just came out.
Are you okay？
Yeah. I hope we can watch them together again next summer.
Yeah. Let's watch them together again next year.
...Yeah.
Ta～ma～ya～！
Anegasaki
Hehe. Hey, hey, do you know the word that goes with it？
Yeah. "Kagiya," right？
Right, correct. "Tamaya" and "Kagiya" were both shop names of famous fireworks makers long ago.
Then, do you know which one came first？
Hmm, which was it？
The answer is...
I don't know either, actually.
What's that supposed to mean？
Ah, look. The next one's going up.
Ka～gi～ya～！
Anegasaki
Thanks for walking me home.
I can't let my girlfriend walk home alone at night.
Hehe. Well then... see you.
Yeah, see you.
(All right, the new term starts today！)
Anegasaki
Hehe, you're all fired up？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Um... let's get along this term too.
Yeah, likewise. Even with school starting, keep up with work too, okay？
Yeah, of course.
(All right, today's the closing ceremony！)
Anegasaki
Hehe. You look like you can't wait for the break.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hahaha... well, yeah.
But don't play around too much just because it's a break, okay？ Try to keep a regular routine？
(Hmm, treating me like a kid as usual...)
(The test results should be posted by now...)
(I nailed the tests this time.)
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. I saw your test results. I was surprised your grades were so good.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I just happened to guess right on what would be on it this time.
No, it's the fruit of your hard work. Hehe.
(The test results should be posted by now...)
(The tests this time were neither good nor bad... just average.)
Anegasaki
Ah, I saw the test results. You did pretty well this time.
Well, so-so.
There's lots to do besides studying, after all. But I think you can do even better.
(Maybe I'll try a little harder...)
(The test results should be posted by now...)
(The tests this time were the worst...)
Anegasaki
...Too bad about the tests.
You saw, huh. I'm ashamed...
There's nothing to be ashamed of. Tests are just to see what you can do, so if you try harder next time... okay？
(Sigh... next time I want to show ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ my good side.)
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. Got a sec？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
Well, today's your birthday, right？ So... here.
A birthday present？
If you don't like it, tell me, okay？ I'll do better next time.
Come on. It's from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so of course I'm happy.
...Yeah, thanks. But I want to know more about your tastes... okay？
Okay... Thanks.
One more present.
Happy birthday.
...Yeah, thanks.
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. Geez, making me look for you, how cheeky？
Huh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
Geez... today's your birthday, right？ So, here, this. A present.
Thanks！
I checked out the toy section too... but you're a big boy now, so I went with something properly high-school-ish.
Toy section...
Hehe, kidding. I think I picked something proper.
Haha, thanks.
Now then...
Huh？
Happy birthday.
Yeah... thanks...
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. I was looking for you.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
Geez... today's the day you get one step closer to being an adult, right？
My birthday...
Hehe, correct. For getting it right... here, a present.
Wow... Thanks. I'm really happy.
Hehe. And like this, you'll keep becoming a more and more wonderful man...
That sounds more like something a mom would say than a girlfriend...
Hehe, I guess I feel half girlfriend, half mom？
Hahaha...
And also...
What？
Happy birthday！
Yeah, thanks...
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. Got just a sec？
What's up？
Today's your birthday, right？ So I brought a present...
Really？
If it's a bother, you don't have to take it... what do you say？
A bother？ No way！ I'm happy, thanks.
Good... then, here. Happy birthday.
Thanks so much. I'll treasure the present.
